title: A Vercel preview of the old branch cannot be signed into; the repo's worktree convention is the cheaper side-by-side
area: Looking at the old app beside the new one (option b)
claim: Vercel does build every pushed branch, so a `design-shell-…-preview` branch gets a URL for free, but DEPLOY.md records that preview URLs fail Auth0 login unless each URL is added to Auth0.
